C1587.title: NIST Mobile Threat Catalog: Physical SIM Swap Threat
C1587.summary: The NIST Mobile Threat Catalog identifies physical SIM swapping as a threat where attackers replace a user's SIM card with a malicious one to execute harmful programs. As a countermeasure, devices with integrated SIM (eSIM) are recommended since eSIMs are harder to physically replace, increasing attack complexity.
